name: Tryphosa
title: A Faithful Worker in the Lord
summary: Tryphosa was a Christian woman in the church at Rome whom Paul greeted in his letter to the Romans. She is mentioned together with Tryphaena as one who worked faithfully in the Lord's service, suggesting that she was active in the work of the church.

keyEvents.title: Greeting from Paul
keyEvents.description: Paul sends a personal greeting to Tryphosa in his letter to the church at Rome, where he acknowledges her service in the Lord's work.

keyEvents.title: Working Together with Tryphaena
keyEvents.description: Tryphosa is mentioned together with Tryphaena, suggesting that the two women worked together in the church. Their names may indicate that they were twins or close relatives.
